overloadMerges.note: The two doc syntax lines differ only in whether the leading '*' is passed (selecting whether object is a name-string vs. a Variable/Field reference); collapsed into one overload with an optional literal-symbol discriminator. Also corrected direction on out-parameters (doc arrow column shows them as command outputs, not inputs) which the mechanical parser had defaulted to 'in'.

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If present, object below is the name of the form object (string); if omitted, object is a variable or field reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

sentinelValues.meaning: Returned (together with modifiers = 0) when object designates several objects in the form that have different shortcut settings.

params.name: modifiers
params.description: Modifier key mask or combination of masks If several modifier keys are combined, the command returns the sum of their mask values.

sentinelValues.meaning: No modifier keys for the shortcut (also returned when object designates several objects with differing settings).
Command key mask (Ctrl under Windows, Command under macOS).
Option key mask (Alt / Option under macOS).
Control key mask (Ctrl under macOS, or right-click under Windows and macOS).

overloadMerges.semanticRole: The OBJECT GET SHORTCUT command returns the keyboard shortcut associated with the object(s) designated by the object and * parameters for the current process.
